description: The frontend capability index: one entry per DECLARED capability, plus the vocabularies the registry enforces. Declared is not installed, installed is not loaded, loaded is not active — nothing in this file is running, and the boot payload must not mention any of it. The source of truth is packages/frontend-lego/manifest/capabilities.json; this index is verified against it by packages/frontend-lego/test/12-knowledge.test.mjs.

declared.title: Translation and locale switching
declared.coordination: Locales, dictionaries and the fallback chain are owned by contracts/localization.contract.md (agent-9 lineage). This LEGO prepares the surfaces; it does not own the dictionaries.

rules: A capability attaches only to a surface declared in manifest/surfaces.json.
activation lazy|manual must name an `entry` module path once the capability is installable; a declared capability owes none.
criticality core may not declare a fallback: a missing core capability must be visible.
trust is inherited; a unit nested under a feature capability is a feature and may only be lowered.
Backend-bound capabilities are not re-declared here: the surface catalog already binds a surface to its backend capability and contract.
A feature this instance cannot serve is answered by the compatibility layer's unsupported map (apps/n8n-lego/src/compat/capability.mjs) — never duplicated here.
